verdict.rationale: Vestd's Data Rooms feature explicitly lets ops users store cap tables and documents (agreements, financials, shareholder docs) in one secure place and control "who gets access," directly matching the permissioned diligence-ready sharing story, supplemented by board-ready governance/reporting docs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the permissioning granularity (e.g., counsel vs investor role-based access), and no evidence of audit logs or expiry controls typical of enterprise data rooms.
